guarantees.claim: prim_packer valid_i is asserted only when both msg_write and sha_en are active.
prim_packer ready_i is asserted only when fifo_wready is high and hmac_fifo_wsel is low.
prim_packer flush_i is driven directly by the hash_process signal.
prim_packer output valid, data, and mask are connected to reg_fifo_wvalid, reg_fifo_wdata, and reg_fifo_wmask respectively.
prim_packer ready output is connected to packer_ready.
prim_packer flush_done_o is connected to packer_flush_done.
prim_packer error output is left unconnected, so any error indication from the packer is ignored.

assumptions.claim: msg_fifo_wdata_endian and msg_fifo_wmask_endian must remain stable while valid_i (msg_write & sha_en) is asserted, satisfying the packer's input protocol.
assumptions.risk: incorrect data or mask may be captured by the packer.

assumptions.claim: fifo_wready and hmac_fifo_wsel must together provide a valid ready handshake (ready_i high) when the packer has valid data, otherwise the packer may stall indefinitely.
assumptions.risk: transaction never completes, causing backpressure or data loss.

assumptions.claim: hash_process must meet prim_packer's flush protocol (likely a one-shot pulse) and valid_i must not be re-asserted until flush completes to avoid data corruption.
assumptions.risk: flush may be missed or partial data may be mixed with new input.

assumptions.claim: hmac_fifo_wsel must remain low whenever the packer needs to write to the register FIFO through reg_fifo_w* signals, because the ready_i gating blocks output when it is high.
assumptions.risk: packer stalls and accumulated data may be lost or overwritten.

uncertain_points.claim: packer_flush_done is connected but the comment 'ignore at this moment' suggests it may not be monitored by surrounding logic; if flush completion is needed for correct sequencing, ignoring it could hide incomplete flush states.
uncertain_points.cond: after hash_process pulse if flush must complete before next operation
uncertain_points.risk: downstream logic may operate on stale data, leading to functional or integrity errors.

uncertain_points.claim: prim_packer error output is left unconnected, so any packer-detected error (even with EnProtection=0) is silently dropped; if the packer can assert err_o under fault conditions, the error will not be handled.
uncertain_points.risk: undetected data corruption may propagate through reg_fifo_wdata/mask.
